description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing Document entities in a Room database. It provides methods for inserting documents, retrieving all documents, and searching documents by title.

classes.name: DocumentDao
classes.description: Interface annotated with @Dao providing database operations for Document entities.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a Document into the database, returning the row ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Document records ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for documents whose titles contain the given query string, ordered by creation date descending.
